# fastnlcd

Fast per-polygon land cover percent and area from **Annual NLCD** (USGS
Collection 1.2, CONUS, 1985–2025). One function.

## Install

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("noahweidig/fastnlcd")
```

## Use

``` r

library(fastnlcd)

nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"))
x <- extract_nlcd(year = 2025, geometry = nc, units = "km2", id = "NAME")
head(x)
#>     id year class           description nlcd_color      area       pct
#> 1 Ashe 2025    11            Open Water    #466B9F  2.927338 0.2573710
#> 2 Ashe 2025    21 Developed, Open Space    #DEC5C5 81.908640 7.2013907
#> ...
```

`geometry` takes an `sf`/`sfc` object, a
[`terra::SpatVector`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatVector-class.html),
or a path to any vector file (shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON…). `units`
is one of `"ha"`, `"km2"`, `"m2"`, `"acres"`, `"mi2"`. Set `wide = TRUE`
to get one row per feature.

## Why it’s fast

- Downloads only the native 30 m tiles your features touch, from the
  USGS WCS. Nothing national.
- Downloads run in parallel over HTTP/2, and tiles are cached on disk. A
  second run over the same area skips the network.
- Requests snap to the NLCD grid, so no resampling.
- Exact pixel coverage fractions in C++ (`exactextractr`).
- `cores = 4` splits extraction across forked workers (Unix/macOS).

Measured in a 4-core cloud container:

| Job                                          | Time |
|----------------------------------------------|------|
| 100 NC counties (≈140k km²), cold cache      | 41 s |
| Same, warm cache                             | 18 s |
| Same, warm cache, `cores = 4`                | 6 s  |
| 20,000 × 500 m buffers across NC, warm cache | 14 s |

## Memory

Features are sorted spatially and run in chunks (`chunk_size`, default
500). Each chunk reads its tiles through a lazy VRT, so a 20,000-feature
run stayed near 215 MB of R memory. Lower `chunk_size` if you run tight
on RAM.

## Output

Long format: `id`, `year`, `class`, `description`, `nlcd_color`, `area`,
`pct`. `nlcd_color` is the official NLCD hex color, so
`ggplot2::scale_fill_identity()` works directly. `pct` is the percent of
the feature’s area that has valid NLCD data. Pixels outside CONUS are
excluded.

## Data

[Annual
NLCD](https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/annual-national-land-cover-database),
USGS EROS, public domain. Served by the MRLC WCS at
`dmsdata.cr.usgs.gov`. Tile access follows the approach in
[lulc-downloader](https://github.com/burchfisher/lulc-downloader).

# Package index

## Extract

- [`extract_nlcd()`](https://noahweidig.github.io/fastnlcd/reference/extract_nlcd.md)
  : Extract Annual NLCD land cover percent and area for polygons
